Scoring Patterns by Match Phase

The 20-over innings is divided into three tactical phases: Powerplay (overs 1-6), Middle Overs (overs 7-15), and Death Overs (overs 16-20). Scoring rates and boundary frequency vary significantly across these phases.

Extras & Bowling Discipline

Extras — wides, no-balls, byes, and leg-byes — represent free runs conceded by the bowling side. In T20 cricket, even 2-3 extra runs per innings can shift match outcomes. This section analyses extras distribution by type, team, and individual bowler.
